title: Migration keeps every score sounding the same
description:
As a user with an existing library, I want to move to the new storage without losing or changing anything.

```gherkin
Feature: Migrating today's files
  Scenario: Every example sounds the same after migration
    Given the repository's samples, manifests, curation library and example scores
    When I migrate them into a new library
    Then every example score renders sample-identical from the library and from the files

  Scenario: Migration is idempotent
    Given a library migrated from the repository
    When I migrate into the same library again
    Then nothing changes
```
